1 published version of [The second run: a forensic look at why a release of this newsroom takes about 24 minutes, measured stage by stage over two timed releases and 437 CI runs since 18 October, what each check protects, what runs twice, what can run side by side, and why, if nothing changed, the second run should do almost no work at all](../the-second-run.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out.
